scope: ENTITY co-occurrence (crime type / legal act / district) within cases. NOT a person network - the FIR extract carries no identities (Indian confidentiality law); person-level link analysis is descoped by design.

graph.held_out_reason: crime_head<->district edges are near-complete bipartite; including them dropped modularity 0.468 -> 0.261. Kept as node metadata + spatial-affinity rules instead.

interpretation: Edges/rules are ASSOCIATIONS between case attributes, not causal links and not relationships between people.
fairness: No person data, no protected attributes. Entities are crime types, legal acts and districts only.
